One image, no sheet, no text, no added features. Keep transparent gaps between hair strands and between twin tails and body.

limitations: Cutout is a generated reinterpretation, not a pixel-exact extraction of the accepted portrait. Small face/hair/shading differences need human review.
Character source has genuine alpha. The three variant sources have painted checkerboard backgrounds, not alpha; only opaque interior facial regions are used.
Packaging resizes to 768x1024, extracts feathered replacement regions, and retains generated skin fills around eyelids/lips. No hand-drawn eyes/mouths or generated video.
Background is a fixed authored CSS Graphite gradient using existing theme tokens, not generated art.
Base contains open eyes and resting closed mouth; blink and mouth patches independently replace their regions. No head/hair/body mesh rig or hidden joint articulation is claimed.
